purpose: Record which existing local source layers can support the material-to-meaning/action bridge without presenting separate units as one causal episode.

sources.material_surface: baseline expense difficulty and later food, energy, job, price, and material transitions
sources.meaning_surface: June confidence in Congress and federal-statistics agreement
sources.boundary: same-ID linkage and replicate-weight descriptive transitions; no dated bill, attribution, remedy, action, or attrition-adjusted population inference

sources.action_surface: six civic-action indicators and any-action composite
sources.time_order: same survey wave; no dated shock
sources.boundary: joint proxy cells show coexistence and heterogeneity; no event, alternative, attribution, or causal ordering

sources.time_order: module-year comparison; not a same-event panel
sources.event_actor: attribution is reported but exact episode actor is not linked
sources.boundary: reported hardship, attribution, and action are separate survey surfaces; no dated bill, remedy, or recovery
temporally ordered descriptive panel contrast; no direct material exposure, attributed actor, remedy, or broader action endpoint

sources.meaning_surface: federal-government trust and responsibility attribution context
sources.action_surface: post-election reported preference for increased government help paying for health insurance
sources.time_order: pre-election concern to post-election policy-preference measure
sources.event_actor: government responsibility is measured as a judgment, not a verified bill or provider episode
sources.boundary: panel/controlled descriptive tables add a policy-demand endpoint but not a dated health-cost event, alternative, remedy, or causal action path

program_result: The strongest local material-to-meaning/action surfaces are separate partial bridges: HTOPS supplies selected same-respondent material timing and judgment but no action; CCES and CES supply action or attribution but not a dated event; ANES supplies worry-to-vote and health-cost-concern-to-policy-preference ordering but not a direct material episode. No source closes the full event-to-actor-to-meaning-to-action chain.

anes_health_cost_concern_to_policy_prefe.interpretation: Descriptive policy-preference contrast; party-conditioned values show why concern is not a universal demand gradient.

ces_medical_affordability_to_action.interpretation: Medical-expense hardship and attribution are observed alongside distinct political acts; year-specific module and model boundaries prevent a pooled causal claim.

next_test: Use a lawful repeated-respondent or event-compatible design that records dated exposure, responsible actor, alternatives, attribution, prior judgment, distinct action, remedy, and later recovery or exit.
storage_boundary: Uses committed local trend records only; no raw-data acquisition or new estimate.
